about: Test-point guidance library — MEER Tool Pro (Round 7, B9). September-patch ke baad naye models par BROM ki software entry (crash preloader / force BROM) aksar band hai; wahan entry physical test point se hoti hai (SEPT-SEC-RESEARCH section 2, Layer 1).

MODEL_CODE.note: TP ki jagah aur tareeqa — apne alfaaz me (masalan: battery connector ke left, sunehra nuqta, 'TP' print).
MODEL_CODE.procedure: Step-by-step: kya kholna hai, kya short karna hai, cable kab lagani hai.
MODEL_CODE.source: Jahan se mila (forum thread / apna bench tajurba + tareekh).

honesty_note: Kisi model ki test-point location is file me sirf TAB jama hogi jab wo kisi public/bharosa-mand source se mili ho ya Hamza ne apne board par khud verify ki ho. Andaze wali location likhna phone/board kharab kar sakta hai — is liye 'models' jaan-boojh kar khali hai; structure mukammal hai, data asal kaam se bharega.
public_basis: UMT public changelogs ka usool: 'Force BROM may not work on new security, use Test Point instead' aur 'Crash Preloader may not work on new security devices'. Is ke ilawa is file me koi per-model location NAHI darj — wajah neeche wali note me hai.
